children: William Monteleone, a direct shareholder and President and CEO, reported two sales of Par Pacific Holdings common stock on September 2 and September 3, 2026. The first sale on September 2 was for 40,000 shares at a weighted average price of $81.30 per share and the second sale on September 3 was for 26,801 shares at $83.00 per share. The total proceeds from the sales were $5,476,483. Following the reported transactions, Monteleone directly owns 457,167 shares of common stock.
